description: This file defines the ImportMap class, which models the import_map table used for mapping configurations during import processes in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for handling field mappings, default values, publishing status, and access control logic related to import mapping.

classes.name: ImportMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping configuration for data import operations, providing methods to get/set mappings and default values, manage publication state, and handle permissions.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns an associative array representing field mappings parsed from the content string.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Sets the content string based on an associative array of field mappings.

methods.name: getDefaultValues
methods.description: Returns an associative array of default field values parsed from the default_values string.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets the default_values string from an associative array of default field values.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID, initializing certain fields like delimiter based on source.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current ImportMap instance, delegating to _save.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, setting fields appropriately.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the import map as deleted, with permission checks.

methods.name: mark_published
methods.description: Marks an import map as published or unpublished, with permission checks.

methods.name: retrieve_all_by_string_fields
methods.description: Retrieves all import maps matching specific field criteria.

methods.name: set_get_import_wizard_fields
methods.description: Sets and gets import wizard related fields in user preferences.
